name: Crimson Heart of the Sanctum
description: A pulsing ruby core that leaks rejuvenating blood magic into your veins.
details: +15 Max HP, and automatically regenerates 2 HP at the end of every active game turn.

name: Unstable Leyline Battery
description: A crystalline sphere buzzing with highly condensed, crackling magical electricity.
details: +10 Max MP, and all grimoire spells cost 3 less MP to cast (minimum cost remains 1 MP).

name: Slight-of-Hand Gloaming Gloves
description: Ultrathin obsidian-threaded gloves that move in perfect unison with your lockpicks.
details: Increases Lockpicking skill score by +4, and lockpicking failure checks are automatically bypassed!

name: Midas Alchemical Crucible
description: A heavy brass chalice that transmutes ordinary lead and carbon scrap into pure, brilliant bullion.
details: Earns 25% extra gold coins whenever looting or trading, and instantly grants 100 gold coins on acquisition.

name: Primal Giant’s Vitriol
description: A bubbling, thick golden syrup extracted from ancient mountain sovereigns.
details: Permanently increases ATK damage rating by +4, and physical weapon swings have a 25% chance to stun enemies for 1 turn.

name: Polished Aegis of Reflection
description: A flawless, mirror-like silver plate that bounces physical and elemental kinetic trajectories.
details: Permanently increases DEF stat rating by +3, and grants a 20% chance to reflect 50% of incoming attack damage back to enemies.

name: Aetheric Loom Needle
description: A needle of concentrated celestial starlight that embroiders magical spell-weaves.
details: All magic grimoire spell damage is increased by +15%, and your Elemental Spell Combos deal +5 flat bonus damage.

name: Featherlight Gale Boots
description: Wind-infused leather boots that lift your weight slightly off terrestrial dirt.
details: Increases Overworld movement speed. Grants permanent Water Walking status and a 20% chance to bypass exhaustion gains entirely.

name: Hyperconducting Lodestone
description: A magnetic alloy block that attracts precious metals, dense raw elements, and rare blueprints.
details: Elite hostiles have double drop frequency. Player backpack capacity limits and item weights are reduced by 30%.

name: Chronicle Quill of the Scribe
description: A golden-nibbed quill that writes history onto the margins, optimizing strategic learning rates.
details: Grants +20% extra experience points (XP) from all combat encounters, secret scouting, and quest board completions.

name: Chaotic Resonance Catalyst
description: An oscillating volatile core that prevents active elemental forces from dispersing.
details: Extends all debuff and elemental affliction status durations on enemies by +2 turns (applied on infusing attacks).

name: Sunder Celestial Sampo 🎡
description: A miraculous cosmic mill of three-sided wealth, originally forged by the divine smith Ilmarinen.
details: Boosts all gold looting/selling gains by +35% and gives a 20% chance per movement turn to manifest +10 Gold or +1 random high-grade alloy.

name: Pike-Jaw Kantele of Väinämöinen 🪕
description: A sacred five-string harp carved from the great pike’s jawbone, strung with horsehair from Hiisi’s stallion.
details: Increases Spell Power by +15% and has a 25% chance during enemy strikes to soothe their anger, reducing incoming strike damage by 30%.

name: Ukonvasara Thunder Bolt 🌩️
description: The ancient copper-forged lightning hammer belonging to Ukko, high god of the skies and storms.
details: Gives +5 bonus ATK power, and physical/elemental attacks have a 30% chance to unleash chain-thunder, dealing 12 light-infused damage to all adjacent enemies.

name: Birch Crown of Mielikki 👑
description: A crown woven from fresh forest birch twigs, forest flowers, and healing mosses, blessed by the Queen of Tapio’s Evergreen Kingdom.
details: Increases all healing effect output by +30% and grants absolute immunity to Swamp Poison, Frostbite, and environmental Trap damage.
